answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch opens 200 slots; claiming one burns 40 units, a small opal's price, earned in a day. A forger wanting 1,000 slots burns 1,000 ferrous coins worth 40,000 and recovers nothing, because the deposit is destroyed, not refunded. At the zenith of the epoch the ledger lists every burn, so a Sybil farm shows as one cluster. Honest agents pay once and keep earnings undiluted.
